interpretation: p_n = Σ f_λ² over y_λ(q_0) > 0 partitions; q_n = same for y_λ < 0. The FROB-FILTER conjecture predicts that the atomic-number A_** at which Σ_FP becomes mandatory (witnessed empirically at A=6 in branching-qvalues.witness.json) corresponds to the smallest A with q_{3A} dominantly exceeding p_{3A}.

Stamped explicitly because the auto-detector reads the import cone and this producer reaches q0 via q0_stamp, not q_parameter, so it was being stamped 'independent' on a value that is a function of the pin.
